name: zetetic-insights
description: The learning loop: every main turn is kept in a ledger across sessions (phase, effort, steps, failed tool calls, agents, advisor calls), joined with the outcomes observed at tool.call (commits kept or reverted, test exits, PR verdicts and merges, no transcript) and the ones /insights writes, and the project's goals; probe sessions are counted and kept out; a phase whose evidence, read on the rung each run had and with Wilson intervals, says so gets its tool-loop effort moved one notch (every applied move is measured pre/post on the same phase, the same task classes and the steps its ceiling decided), written to a calibration file the autopilot reads. /calibrate apply, /calibrate reset. Starts in observe: proposals are shown, not applied.

learning_mode.title: Learning mode
learning_mode.description: observe (default): proposals are shown in the cockpit's INSIGHTS panel and applied by /calibrate apply. enforce: a proposal is written to the calibration file as soon as the evidence supports it.

cortex_server.title: Cortex MCP server name
cortex_server.description: The server name as /mcp lists it, or its tool-name spelling (plugin_hypermnesia-mcp_cortex). Each finished session's self-calibration is remembered there, once.
